FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At MedSupply Plus, we operate as a comprehensive retail medical and hospital supply store providing a wide range of verified, certified, and FDA-approved medical equipment and supplies. Our core operations focus on ensuring compliance with all relevant health and safety regulations while maintaining a clean and well-organized retail space. We take pride in our proactive measures, which include regular staff training on equipment safety, customer service, and emergency procedures. Additionally, our operations incorporate strict inventory management practices that track product recalls and expiration dates, ensuring the quality of items distributed. Our team is dedicated to customer safety, ensuring that all rental equipment undergoes thorough sanitization and maintenance between uses. Through these measures, we strive to deliver high-quality service and products while maintaining our reputation within the healthcare community.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: MedSupply Rentals LLC, Health City, CA - Specializing in temporary medical equipment rental services and compliance training for proper equipment use.
